title: Applied AI Intern - Warsaw
descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is building the data and applications platform for the AI era. We are looking for an Applied AI Intern to join our engineering team in Warsaw and help build, evaluate, and deploy AI applications for real customer use cases.

You will work with experienced AI engineers and researchers on production-oriented systems such as AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, LLM integrations, and data applications. You will gain experience taking a solution from prototype to production and contributing to reusable engineering assets and platform improvements.

What We Offer

  • Paid, full-time internship on the Applied AI engineering team

  • Mentorship, regular feedback, and support from experienced AI engineers and researchers

  • Hands-on work with Snowflake Cortex, Snowpark, Python, SQL, and modern AI development tools

  • Exposure to the engineering lifecycle, including design, implementation, evaluation, testing, deployment, and monitoring

  • Opportunities to present your work, collaborate with Product and Engineering, and be considered for future full-time or internship roles

What You Will Do

  • Build and iterate on AI pipelines, agents, and data applications within team-led customer or product engagements

  • Turn business goals into engineering tasks, prototypes, and measurable outcomes with guidance from senior engineers

  • Contribute to evaluation frameworks, test datasets, observability, and experiments that improve AI quality

  • Help productionize solutions through reliability, safety guardrails, monitoring, and human-review workflows

  • Collaborate with customer data science and engineering teams while writing clean, tested Python and SQL

  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, debugging, documentation, and other software development activities

What We Expect

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed (within the last 12 months) a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field

  • Interest in ML, LLMs, generative AI, RAG, AI agents, or data-intensive applications

  • Strong programming skills in Python

  • Familiarity with version control, testing, debugging, and code reviews

  • Ability to work independently on well-scoped tasks, collaborate effectively, and communicate technical ideas clearly

Nice to Have

  • A project involving LLMs, RAG, agents, machine learning, or data systems

  • Experience with Snowflake, Snowpark, Cortex, Streamlit, Spark, or AWS, Azure, or GCP

  • Understanding of distributed systems, model serving, or inference infrastructure

  • Experience creating evaluation datasets, test suites, benchmarks, or observability for AI systems

  • Previous internship, research, open-source, or personal software engineering experience

What You Will Learn

  • How to build and deploy production-oriented AI applications, including agents, RAG systems, and LLM integrations

  • How to define quality metrics, evaluate AI behavior, and use structured testing to identify failure modes and prevent regressions

  • How to apply reliability, safety, monitoring, observability, and human-in-the-loop practices

  • How to scope ambiguous problems, make engineering trade-offs, collaborate with customers, and present technical work

Internship Details

  • Location: Warsaw, Poland

  • Duration: Minimum 4 months; 6 months recommended; up to 12 months supported

  • Working arrangement: Full-time

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com
